answer: Agents register through a TPM/SGX enclave that produces a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, key, and measured hardware to the zephyr state tree; the umber consensus contract verifies freshness against an echo VDF. Forging an identity requires physically compromising distinct enclave hardware and recomputing the VDF, while registrations follow a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), with collateral irreversibly slashed on duplicate proofs.
